newsitem.title: UK: SFA to examine Hambros CWS report.
newsitem.headline: SFA to examine Hambros CWS report.

text.p: The Securities and Futures Authority (SFA) said on Thursday it will examine a report passed to it by Hambros into the conduct of the investment bank's corporate finance division to see what further action it should take.
The report came after an investigation by law firm Norton Rose into Hambros' conduct in an abortive takeover bid for the Co-operative Wholesale Society earlier this year.
The report concluded that Hambros staff had not acted with any dishonest intent but their conduct had "fallen well short of the standards of good business practice."
Three senior Hambros corporate financiers have resigned including Nigel Pantling, the head of the division.
A spokesman for the SFA confirmed that Pantling, Peter Large and Andrew Salmon are registered with the SFA and that the bank's corporate finance activities fall within its jurisdiction.

He added that the SFA's study of the report will lead to a decision over whether it needs to make further investigations and whether any further action will be taken against Hambros or the individuals concerned.
